ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low ratio; the surface is predominantly comprised of low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized water droplets and distal barnacle clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central notch with sharp vertex definition and symmetrical inward penetration.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with moderate-amplitude serrations; the left lobe displays more pronounced peaks and valleys compared to the relatively finer serrations on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curvature that transitions into narrow, upwardly-swept distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, high-contrast tan and white pixel clusters located exclusively at the terminal distal tips of both fluke lobes, corresponding to barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustations concentrated at the lateral tips of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, high-intensity circular specular highlights distributed across the fluke surface caused by water adhesion.
